lines.beaver_en: How's the year-end fair prep going?
lines.en: Honestly, it's tough. We're the hosts.

lines.learner: 개막식 준비랑 부스 설치가 겹쳐서 바빠요.
lines.en: Opening ceremony prep and booth setup overlap, so I'm busy.
lines.roman: gaemaksik junbirang buseu seolchiga gyeopcheoseo bappayo.

lines.learner: 네, 폭죽은 안전 문제가 까다로운 면이 있어요.
lines.en: Yes, fireworks are tricky in terms of safety.
lines.roman: ne, pokjugeun anjeon munjega kkadaroun myeoni isseoyo.

lines.learner: 네, 같은 주에 부장님 회갑연이 있어요.
lines.en: Yes, the manager's 60th birthday party is that week.
lines.roman: ne, gateun jue bujangnim hoegabyeoni isseoyo.

lines.beaver_en: Oh, his 60th birthday! Got a gift ready?
lines.learner: 아직요. 그리고 주말엔 아버지 산소에도 가야 해요.
lines.en: Not yet. And I must visit my father's grave this weekend.
lines.roman: ajigyo. geurigo jumaren abeoji sansoedo gaya haeyo.

lines.beaver_en: Is it his memorial day? You must be swamped.
lines.learner: 네. 게다가 어제는 친구 빈소에도 다녀왔어요.
lines.en: Yes. And yesterday I went to a friend's funeral hall.
lines.roman: ne. gedaga eojeneun chingu binsoedo danyeowasseoyo.

lines.beaver_en: Oh no, that must have been hard.
lines.learner: 조문하고 유족을 위로하느라 일을 못 했어요.
lines.en: I paid my respects and comforted the family, so I couldn't work.

lines.beaver: 그럼 박람회 일은 제가 좀 더 맡을게요.
lines.beaver_en: Then I'll take on more of the fair work.
lines.beaver_roman: geureom bangnamhoe ireun jega jom deo mateulgeyo.
lines.learner: 고마워요. 폭죽 업체에 연락해 주실 수 있어요?
lines.en: Thanks. Could you contact the fireworks company?
lines.roman: gomawoyo. pokjuk eopchee yeollakae jusil su isseoyo?

lines.beaver_en: Of course. Let's sort out the ceremony order together too.
lines.learner: 좋아요. 혼자 하면 부담스러운 면이 있었거든요.
lines.en: Great. Doing it alone felt like a lot of pressure.
lines.roman: joayo. honja hamyeon budamseureoun myeoni isseotgeodeunyo.

lines.beaver: 같이 하면 금방 끝날 거예요. 힘내요!
lines.beaver_en: Together we'll finish soon. Cheer up!
lines.beaver_roman: gachi hamyeon geumbang kkeunnal geoyeyo. himnaeyo!
lines.learner: 고마워요. 송년 행사 잘 마무리해 봐요.
lines.en: Thanks. Let's wrap up the year-end event well.
lines.roman: gomawoyo. songnyeon haengsa jal mamurihae bwayo.
